that DECIDES the production length, so until it has been done the length in
configs/openqha.yaml is provisional and every free energy computed from a shorter
The SCIENCE settings are not here. The timestep, the thermostat and its coupling
time, the three prohibitions and the standard state live in the driver, in
_one_trajectory_not_a_ladder: Run ONE long trajectory per seed and read the ladder off its PREFIXES. Running
200 ps, 500 ps and 1 ns as three separate jobs costs 1.7 ns of force calls to learn
what the 1 ns run already contains, and its three points would differ by both length
AND seed -- so a difference between them could not be attributed.
The seeds still differ, and must: the spread BETWEEN seeds at a fixed prefix is
acceptance criterion 5, the blank control. Measured on the 25 ps run, that spread
shrinks from 0.9640 kcal/mol at 3 ps to 0.0533 at 25 ps -- a smooth curve from one
seed would have shown none of that, and a smooth curve can be smoothly wrong.
_what_the_literature_expects: This is not a fast-converging quantity and the published record is blunt:
'convergence is not complete over 200 ps, and about 4 ns are needed'.
Rinaldo & Field 2003 (Biophys. J. 85, 3485), the protocol this branch follows:
520 ps of EQUILIBRATION was necessary where 20 ps was planned; then 1.5 ns of
data collection sampled every 0.5 ps -- and the entropies were still 'converging
Branch B's molecules are 10-19 atoms, not a solvated protein, so far fewer soft
modes have to be sampled and this should converge much sooner. SHOULD BE is not a
length, which is why this benchmark exists.
Measured here so far: at 25 ps the last doubling still moved T*S by +0.4684
kcal/mol against a 0.3 budget. Not converged, exactly as above would predict.

cost._status: EXTRAPOLATED from a measured unit rate. Read the warning.
cost.measured_conditions: acetone (10 atoms), MACE-OFF23_medium, float64, 1 thread, CPU, uncontended, 2026-09-03
_warning: 96.1 s/ps is a SINGLE-TRAJECTORY, UNCONTENDED number for ONE species. The cost
with many concurrent trajectories on one node has not been measured, and this
figure must not be divided by a worker count to produce one (D0-P1-12, defects 34
and 56). On a contended machine this session measured up to 919 s/ps -- nearly ten
times worse -- so a walltime request built from 96.1 alone will be short.
Request walltime for the 1 ns run at 3x the extrapolation, or run it in resumable
chunks, which the driver already supports.

_why: A 1 ns trajectory will not fit in one queue slot on most sites. The driver takes
--wall-budget-s, stops at a chunk boundary once past it, and leaves a resumable
state.npz + frames.npy; resubmitting continues rather than restarting. That is
what makes a 1 ns run practical under a 24 h limit.
NOTE the route difference: the ASE driver checkpoints positions AND momenta, so a
resumed trajectory is bit-identical to an uninterrupted one. The OpenMM driver
flushes frames but does NOT checkpoint the Nose-Hoover chain's extended-system
variables, so a resumed trajectory there is a valid canonical sample but not the
same one. For a benchmark whose whole point is comparing prefixes, prefer the ASE
route or a walltime that fits the run.

_memory_why: 4 GB rather than the 3 of a 25 ps run: 1 ns at 8 fs sampling is 125000 frames,
which is 30 MB of float64 positions for a 10-atom molecule and about 60 MB for a
19-atom one, plus the analysis holding a fitted copy. Comfortable, not tight.

_why: As the production config. A trajectory that fails the molecular-integrity check
will fail it again from the same basin with the same seed. Cluster resource
configs raise this to 1 for pre-emption, which is not reproducible, and a
pre-empted task here resumes from its chunk rather than restarting.

acceptance.saturation: the last doubling of prefix length moves T*S by less than 0.3 kcal/mol on EVERY seed -- not on the mean, because a mean hides one bad seed
acceptance.below_the_noise_floor: that increment must also be smaller than the between-seed spread at the same prefix; an increment smaller than the budget but larger than the noise floor means the curve is still moving and the budget is too loose for this system
acceptance.modes_stable: the number of non-zero eigenvalues stays 3N-6 at every prefix. Rinaldo & Field's total entropy failed to converge because the MODE COUNT was still growing, not because the values were drifting -- 3000 frames gave 3000 eigenvalues where 7758 were expected. That is acceptance criterion 10 and it is why the count is printed at every point
acceptance.the_answer_goes_in_config: the shortest converged prefix is written into configs/openqha.yaml as the production length, citing this run's log. A length that lives only in a script's default is a length nobody can find
